name: OneDayOne
source:
A visual novel where you will dive into the routine life of Sergey, from which only a miracle and...your choices can help him escape.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3334200/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在這部視覺小說中，你將走進謝爾蓋周而復始的日常。只有奇蹟，以及……你的選擇，能幫他從中脫身。
